hero_p2: Cross-platform desktop apps in Go, native UI or WebView, shipped as a few MB.

ui_p: A MyGo window shows native UI or a web page, and each library here is marked with the one it is for. These are component libraries, themes and icons made for MyGo apps; the components native UI ships with are in the official docs.
ui_cta: Custom title bars, tray panels, drop zones: components made for MyGo are welcome.
state_p: Desktop app state spans Go, the frontend and every window. MyGo ships typed IPC, channels and events that community solutions build on.
blk_bind_d: Expose Go services and call them from the frontend through a generated TypeScript client.
blk_chan_d: Stream values to the frontend through Go channels: progress, logs, live data.
blk_evt_d: Send typed events between Go and the frontend, e.g. to broadcast state changes across windows.
state_empty_h: Be the first state solution listed
state_empty_p: For example: mapping a Go store to React / Vue / Svelte reactive state, syncing state across windows, local persistence.
tpl_p: mygo init gives you a minimal app. A template starts you further along: a frontend stack, a design system, tests, CI and packaging already in place.
tpl_empty_p: For example: a native UI app with packaging and updates set up, a React or Vue frontend with typed bindings, an app with tests and CI.
ai_p: AI coding agents write more and more MyGo code. These skills, MCP servers and rules teach them its APIs, conventions and how to test what they build.
ai_empty_h: Be the first AI tool listed
ai_empty_p: For example: an agent skill for MyGo's native UI, an MCP server that drives MyGo views in tests, AGENTS.md rules for MyGo projects.
plug_p: Official plugins: for web pages, a Go package plus an npm package; for native UI, all Go.
tool_p: Create, develop and build MyGo apps; mygo doctor checks your machine.
comm_p: Write one with the official Plugins guide, then submit it here.
